newsitem.title: CUBA: Castro holds talks with Jamaican premier.
newsitem.headline: Castro holds talks with Jamaican premier.

text.p: Cuban President Fidel Castro and Jamaican Prime Minister P.J. Patterson discussed regional integration in the Caribbean on Thursday, official media reported.
The Cuban news agency Prensa Latina said the two leaders discussed bilateral relations and regional integration, but gave no further details of their talks.
Patterson, accompanied by a trade delegation, arrived in the Cuban capital on Wednesday on a four-day visit, the first by a Jamaican premier to Cuba in two decades.

At a summit grouping Caribbean leaders and U.S. President Bill Clinton earlier this month, Patterson criticised the U.S. policy of isolating Cuba, saying the communist-ruled island should be more integrated into the region.
